name: excel-csv-mapper
description: Excel → CSV Mapper — Excel Add-in for mapping worksheet data to CSV templates

scripts.deploy: npm run build && git add docs && git commit -m 'Deploy to Pages' && git push
scripts.sideload: npm run dev & sleep 6 && mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef" && cp src/manifest.local.xml "$HOME/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef/manifest.local.xml" && echo '✅ Local add-in installed. Restart Excel, then Home > Add-ins > Excel → CSV Mapper (Local).'
